tabsize.description: Number of spaces per tab (must be ≥1)

keytimeout_ms.description: Time in milliseconds nano waits for additional characters in escape sequences (e.g., arrow keys); lower values improve responsiveness but may break some sequences on slow connections.

tabs_to_spaces.description: When true, insert spaces instead of tab characters on Tab key press.

dos.description: If true, use DOS-style line endings (CRLF) and enable DOS-specific options.

no_color.description: If true, disable color output (useful for terminals without color support).

syntax_include_paths.description: List of paths (files or wildcards) to include for syntax highlighting definitions. Each entry is a path to a .nanorc file or directory of such files.

key.description: Keybinding in nano syntax (e.g., '^R' for Ctrl+R, 'M-/' for Alt+/)

action.description: Action to bind to the key (e.g., 'redo', 'undo', 'copy', 'paste')

custom_keybindings.description: List of custom keybindings. Each item defines a key, action, and optional mode.
